rules.explanation: Career goal is not clear enough to select a specific path.
The user needs income soon, so a career path is prioritized.
The user does not currently want to pursue further study.
The user is unsure about further study, so an actionable career step is prioritized.
The user needs to strengthen basic data and technology skills before pursuing the main work opportunity.
The preparation recommendation focuses on strengthening basic data and technology skills.
The user has basic skills but still needs professional experience.
The preparation recommendation focuses on gaining internship or equivalent professional experience.
The user has a clear goal, basic skills, and initial professional experience.
The user wants further study and requires a funding path.
The user wants further study and can focus on academic and application preparation.
Further study remains a parallel plan while near-term income is prioritized.
A completed project provides evidence of applied skills but is not treated as professional experience.
The existing project can be improved and aligned with the target opportunity.
Interest in data processing and dashboards supports Data Analyst as the first exploration path.
Interest in predictive modeling supports Data Scientist as the first exploration path.
Interest in building applications or systems supports Software or IT as the first exploration path.
Interest in experiments and research supports Researcher as the first exploration path.
Interest in biological or genomic data supports Bioinformatics Analyst as the first exploration path.
Interest in clinical studies and patient data supports Clinical Research as the first exploration path.
Interest in quality and compliance supports Quality Assurance or Regulatory Affairs as the first exploration path.
Interest in designing health services supports Health Product or Business Analysis as the first exploration path.
Interest in explaining science supports Medical Writing or Science Communication as the first exploration path.
